description: Reset the CMAK access account password for a CDSS cluster. CMAK is being phased out by Ncloud (the CMAK restart API ended 2026-09-17); this operation is still documented but may be discontinued.

kafkaManagerUserPassword.description: New CMAK password (8-20 chars, letters+numbers+special; excludes ' " ` ₩ / & and spaces)

name: ncloud_cdss_reset_cmak_password
